Jwt.//: Signs every login token — never commit a real value. Set via `dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:Key ...` locally, or the host's environment-variable/config mechanism in production.

Google.//: OAuth 2.0 Web-application Client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials). Leave blank to keep Google sign-in disabled — POST /api/auth/google then returns 400. Must be the SAME value as the frontend's VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.
